info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: " Yi zvapa - Saye . ' halantyam ' (1.3.3) iti ItvaprasaNgAt ' Yi zvap Saye ' iti apapAWaH iti DAtukAvyavyAKyAyAm . (2.51) yujyate cEtat . yataH sarvezu api DAtupAWezu ' Yi zvap Saye . udAttet . anudAttaH ' iti paWyate . ' udAttet ' ityasya udAttopadeSaH akAraH itsaMjYakaH atra ityeva Kalu arTaH ? ataSca prAmAdikaH sArvatrikaH ' zvap ' iti halantyapAWaH ityeva nyAyyam . ataH eva apapAWaH SoDitaH DAtukAvyavyAKyAtfmahASayena " iti kfdantarUpamAlA .

examples: 'tataH prasizvide kfzRaH svinnaScArjunamabravIt' (BA॰droRa॰19.21). praSabda AdikarmaRi syAdanarTako vA. prakarzadyotakastu na. svinna ityanantarokteH.
'aTa rAtryAM vyatItAyAmavasuptamanantaram' (rA0 2.56.1). avasuptamIzat suptam iti tilakakAro rAmaH.
'taM Sabdamavasuptastu jawAyuraTa SuSruve' (rA0 3.50.1). ukto'rTaH. sTAne'vaSabdaprayogo vaSyavAcaH kaveH. Izatsupta eva SabdaM SfRuyAnna prasuptaH suzupto vA.
'iyaM padmAvatyavasuptA (svapna0 5). atrAsTAne'vaH. na hyatra svApasyAlpatA'BipretA. leKakapramAdo vA'yaM syAt.

'acakitamavasuptaM pARqavAnAmanIkam. niSi suniSitaSastro droRasUnurjaGAna' (kA0 nI0 sA0 19.71).. atrAvaH sutamAmanizwaH, arTaM hi viparyAsayati. gAQaM suptAnAmeva pARqavAnAM vaDaH Sakyo drORinA na tvavasuptAnAmIzatsuptAnAm. manye kAmandako'trAnarTakamavaM prayuNkte svApamAtraM ca vivakzate.
'tadAhurnAgnirupasTeyaH kaSSreyAMsaM vizuptaM boDayizyatIti' (Apa0 SrO0 6.7.2.7.1). vizuptaM prasuptaM suzuptam.
'kimasmAnducCunAyase ni zu svapa' (f0 7.55.4). nIcEH susvapihItyAha. niSabdo'Do'rTe. suH sOzWave.
